name: RAISE
fullName: Reteplase versus Alteplase for Acute Ischemic Stroke
population: n=1412, adults, NIHSS 4-25 (ages 18-80; patients planned for endovascular treatment excluded), ≤4.5 h
teachingPoint: Reteplase beat alteplase for mRS 0-1 within 4.5 h but with more ICH overall; not a default agent outside the trial setting.
